questions.q: From P(-6, 2), perpendiculars are dropped to the x-axis and y-axis at M and N respectively. Which coordinates must M and N have?
questions.explanation: A perpendicular from P to the x-axis keeps the same x-coordinate and makes the y-coordinate zero, so M is (-6, 0). A perpendicular from P to the y-axis keeps the same y-coordinate and makes the x-coordinate zero, so N is (0, 2). These are exactly the axis-foot coordinates used in the Exemplar.

questions.q: Three vertices of a rectangle are (3, 2), (-4, 2) and (-4, 5), in that order around the rectangle. What is the fourth vertex?
questions.explanation: The first two vertices have the same ordinate 2, so that side is horizontal. The second and third have the same abscissa -4, so the next side is vertical. The fourth vertex must therefore have x-coordinate 3 from the first vertex and y-coordinate 5 from the third vertex, giving (3, 5).

questions.q: Among P(-1,1), Q(3,-4), R(1,-1), S(-2,-3) and T(-4,4), which points lie in the fourth quadrant?
questions.explanation: A point lies in the fourth quadrant when its x-coordinate is positive and its y-coordinate is negative. Q(3,-4) and R(1,-1) both have the sign pattern (+,-). The other points either have negative x-coordinates or positive y-coordinates, so they are not in quadrant IV.

questions.q: For P(3,4), which combined statement is correct?
options: A) P is in quadrant II; its distances from the y-axis and x-axis are 3 and 4 units.
B) P is in quadrant I; its distances from the y-axis and x-axis are 4 and 3 units.
C) P is on the x-axis; its distance from the y-axis is 3 units.
D) P is in quadrant I; its distances from the y-axis and x-axis are 3 and 4 units.
questions.answer: D) P is in quadrant I; its distances from the y-axis and x-axis are 3 and 4 units.
questions.explanation: Both coordinates of P are positive, so P lies in the first quadrant. The perpendicular distance from the y-axis is the absolute value of the x-coordinate, which is 3. The perpendicular distance from the x-axis is the absolute value of the y-coordinate, which is 4.
